name: History Lab
tagline: Replay history — and fact-check the AI to win.
description: A branching, illustrated historical decision game where catching the AI's hallucinations is the core mechanic. Anna's host agent streams a grounded scene and three plausible choices and generates period art; before the timeline advances, you must Approve its 'Historian's Ruling' or Flag it as a hallucination. Only approved rulings commit to durable state, while your fact-checking accuracy updates live. AI generates, the human ratifies, Anna remembers.
_comment_bundled_executas: Tool Executas that ship inside this app. `anna-app apps publish` publishes each one, substitutes its server-minted tool_id into every `bundled:<handle>` reference in manifest.json (in memory) and writes bundle/anna-tool-ids.js. Only RUNTIME executas (python/node/go/binary) can be bundled here — the `anna-app dev` harness resolves bundled handles to a runnable process. The `historian-gm` Skill is a declarative Executa published separately (`anna-app executa publish ./executas/historian-gm`); its grounding is already active in-app via manifest.system_prompt_addendum + each scenario's systemPrompt.
